title: 37178 跟进：资料包目录被截断时，没列出的章节也要能读到
body:
repo:objectstack#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzi4PechTRCTBrfxV8W

Filing gate: ③ maintainer-directed (topic #36996 handed to seat 3). Source: nit N2 of the L1 ACCEPT on PR #37222 (#37178), comment 7153812992, accepted for a follow-up card.
Grading: area:ai · Task · p2 (topic child; before row 9 serves the tool in-app, cloud#4978) · evidence: read.

Blocked-by: #37222

## 维护者速读
- 背景：#37178 给资料包正文目录设了 80 条上限。标题层级不同时，没列出的小标题落在某个已列章节下面，读那个章节就能看到；但如果所有标题都在同一层（比如 300 个并列的二级标题），超出的章节没有任何锚点露出来，AI 就没有办法读到它们。
- 另外，截断提示里那句「已列章节的正文包含它下面的标题」在这种情况下会误导。
- 要做的：定一个让 AI 能拿到被截掉章节的办法（例如目录分页：带一个偏移再取下一段目录），并改正那句提示。
- 要你做的：无。

## What
Measured on PR #37222's head `2831c87e` (on `main` once it merges).
1. `boundedOutline` (`packages/services/service-record-context/src/body-outline.ts`) admits headings shallowest level first under `RECORD_CONTEXT_OUTLINE_MAX_ENTRIES` (80) and a character bound. In a flat cut every omitted heading sits under no listed section, so its anchor is never issued and its section cannot be read through `get_record_context` (an anchor is derived from the heading text alone; a model cannot be expected to guess it).
2. Decide how an omitted section is reached and implement it. Candidates to weigh in the PR: a continuation of the outline (an offset / `outlineFrom` input on the tool, returning the next page of headings with the same caps), or listing the omitted headings' anchors in a compact form. Any new tool input is a published widening of `get_record_context`'s input (`packages/spec/src/ai/record-context-tools.zod.ts`): declare `Clause-②` and owe the L2.
3. Fix the `outline_truncated` note sentence (en and zh-Hans, `packages/services/service-record-context/src/sentences.ts`) so it is true for a flat cut.
4. Fold the accepted prose nits of the same review where they touch the same lines: N4 (the changeset's "only heading" wording) needs no change once merged; N3 (one very long first-admitted heading drops the whole outline to truncated text) may be revisited if the paging design makes it cheap, else stated as is.

## Acceptance
- A body of 300 headings at one level: every section is reachable through the tool by anchors it issued, each answer within the existing bounds.
- The note sentence is true for a nested cut and for a flat cut; both pinned by test.

## Out of scope
- ADR-0160's D3 naming the outline cap (N5): carried by the ADR-0160 amendment of #37202. If this card adds a tool input, the ADR text for it is that card's or a later amendment's, stated in the PR.

Parent: #36996. Related: #37178, #37222, #37202.
Dedupe words: `outline_truncated` · `RECORD_CONTEXT_OUTLINE_MAX_ENTRIES` · `get_record_context outline offset` · `context pack outline omitted section`.
